description: For a workflow with a PDF or Excel target: that file filled with a job's values, saved on this machine (never into the chat). With workflow, the job is one of its samples and the file is filled as the draft would.

save_to.description: Where to save it, e.g. out/acord-125.pdf.

target.description: The target's id, from the job's result.targets or the workflow's draft.

workflow.description: For a sample: the workflow, to fill it as its draft would.

name: save_filled_file
title: Save a filled PDF or Excel
